Warmup.name: Single Arm Circles
Warmup.notes: Rotate arm in a large circle slowly. Movement can be both forward and backward. Try to create a larger circle with each rep.

Warmup.name: Standing Knee Circles
Warmup.notes: Rotate each knee in large circles around the hip. Cross over the stance leg and open the hip. Try to create a larger circle with each rep.

Warmup.name: Woodchoppers
Warmup.notes: Feet set wide. Reach all the way overhead then swing down through the legs to dynamically stretch the posterior chain.

Warmup.name: Big Circles
Warmup.notes: Feet set wide. Rotate the upper body all the way around.

Warmup.name: Arm Swings
Warmup.notes: Swing arms back and forth, try to hug yourself when crossing over. Alternate swinging over and under with each rep.

Warmup.name: Rotation Swings
Warmup.notes: Rotate back and forth swinging back arm to stretch across the torso and chest. Rotate back hip. Keep back arm above shoulder height to stretch the pecs.

Warmup.name: Good Mornings
Warmup.notes: Back flat with hands crossed over chest. Knees bent, push hips back.

Warmup.name: Hip Flexor Steps
Warmup.notes: Pushup position, step outside the hand and drive hips to the ground.

Warmup.name: Hamstring Raise
Warmup.notes: Athletic position stance. Grab feet and squat down low. Keep the chest tall in the bottom position with elbows inside the knees. Straighten legs to stretch hamstrings, keep hold of feet

Warmup.name: Side to Side
Warmup.notes: Feet facing straight ahead, laterally shift weight back and forth. Keep weight through the heels. Hips stay level throughout the movement. No up and down.

Warmup.name: Single RDL
Warmup.notes: Arms out at the side with thumbs up. Keep leg and spine locked together as you bend over at the hip. Keep pelvis square.

Warmup.name: Quick Ankle Hops
Warmup.notes: Popping off the midfoot with legs straight. Pulls toes up in between contacts. As fast as possible.
